verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects. The agent executes tool calls and commands under a permission model (write commands ask once, destructive ones always ask), and can branch, create worktrees and commit, which implies it could run code to reproduce and check fixes. Nothing explicitly documents debugging, test execution or root-cause analysis. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running tests or reproducing bugs, root-cause or debugging workflows, fix-verification support, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
